findings.title: Common path requirement understated on G-0
findings.checked: The common path of egress travel requirement stated in the code data block, against Table 1006.2.1 for the occupancy and sprinkler status declared on this sheet.
findings.result: G-0 states 50 LF required. Table 1006.2.1, Group A with a sprinkler system, is 75 feet. Provided is 38'-2", so there is no physical deficiency — but the stated requirement is wrong.

findings.title: Risk Category III does not match the stated occupant load
findings.checked: The assigned risk category against Table 1604.5 and the occupant load stated on the same sheet.
findings.result: Risk Category III is assigned. Table 1604.5 sets RC III at a primary assembly occupancy with an occupant load greater than 300. The stated occupant load is 70. RC III is conservative — it raises design wind pressures — but it is inconsistent with the occupant load on the same sheet.
findings.action: Confirm Risk Category II, or state the basis for III.

findings.title: Building area disagrees between sheets
findings.checked: The building area stated on each general sheet, compared, and the basis stated for each.
findings.result: G-0 states 1,436 SF; the G-1 occupancy tables total 1,375 SF. Difference 61 SF (4.2 percent). Most likely gross versus net, but Table 1004.5 factors are basis-specific, so the basis has to be explicit or the occupant load cannot be independently checked.
findings.action: Label both areas with their basis (gross or net).

findings.title: Travel distance limit — correct
findings.checked: The stated travel distance limit against Table 1017.2 for this occupancy and sprinkler status.
findings.result: Table 1017.2, Group A with a sprinkler system = 250 feet. Sheet states 250 LF, provided 69'-4".

findings.title: Dead-end limit 20 LF — correct for Group A
findings.checked: The stated dead-end limit against 1020.5 and the group list in its sprinklered exception.
findings.result: 1020.5 sets 20 feet. The 50-foot sprinklered exception covers Groups B, E, F, I-1, M, R-1, R-2, S, U only — Group A is not in the list, so 20 feet governs. Sheet states 20 LF.

findings.title: Corridor width and the 1020.3 citation are both correct
findings.checked: The stated corridor width and the section number cited beside it against the 2023 FBC text.
findings.result: Table 1020.3, 'any facilities not listed' = 44 inches. Sheet states 44", provided 60". In the 2023 FBC the width requirement sits at 1020.3 — older editions number it differently, so the citation is worth confirming and it is right.
